description_en: Queries the current bandwidth of an ApsaraDB for Tair (Redis® OSS-Compatible) database instance
description_zh: 查询云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）实例当前的带宽
name: DescribeIntranetAttribute

AutoRenewal.description_en:
Indicates whether auto-renewal is enabled for the purchased bandwidth. Valid values:
true: Enabled.
false: Disabled.

This parameter is not returned if no bandwidth is purchased
AutoRenewal.description_zh:
购买的带宽是否开启了自动续订，取值：
true：已开启。
false：未开启。

如果未购买带宽，则不返回本参数

BandwidthExpireTime.description_en: The expiration time of the purchased bandwidth. The time is in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. This parameter is not returned if no additional bandwidth is purchased for the instance
BandwidthExpireTime.description_zh: 购买带宽的过期时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。 如果实例未购买额外的带宽，则不返回本参数

BandwidthPrePaid.description_en:
The billing method of the bandwidth plan. Valid values:
0: Pay-as-you-go.
1: Subscription
BandwidthPrePaid.description_zh:
带宽包付费类型，取值：
0：按量付费。
1：预付费

ExpireTime.description_en: The expiration time of the temporary bandwidth. The time is in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. This parameter returns 0 if no temporary bandwidth adjustment has been performed on the instance or the temporary bandwidth has expired
ExpireTime.description_zh: 临时带宽的过期时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。 如果实例未执行过临时调整带宽或临时带宽已过期，本参数返回0

HasPrePaidBandWidthOrderRunning.description_en:
Indicates whether the instance has an unexpired bandwidth plan. Valid values:
true: The instance has an unexpired bandwidth plan.
false: The instance does not have an unexpired bandwidth plan.

This parameter is not returned if no additional bandwidth is purchased for the instance
HasPrePaidBandWidthOrderRunning.description_zh:
实例是否有未到期的带宽包，取值：
true：存在未到期的带宽包。
false：不存在未到期的带宽包。
如果实例未购买额外的带宽，则不返回本参数

IntranetBandWidthBurst.description_en: The burst quota for the internal network bandwidth

IntranetBandwidth.description_en: The current internal network bandwidth of the instance. This value is the sum of the bandwidth of all shards in the instance. Unit: MB/s
IntranetBandwidth.description_zh: 实例当前的内网带宽，本参数为实例中所有分片的带宽总和，单位MB/s
